capabilities: Designate notes as pinned share-menu targets on Android/iOS
Append shared text and links using a global or per-note template
Include file bookmarks from Obsidian Bookmarks in the share menu
Auto-update pinned note paths after renames or moves
Optionally open the target note after saving
disambiguation: Not a note-pinning or pinboard tool; "pinned" notes are simply capture targets shown in the mobile share menu.
extras: Supports beta testing via the BRAT plugin; manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Include your Obsidian bookmarked notes (file bookmarks only) in the share menu
motivation: The author built it to reduce the friction of saving information on the go from a mobile device.
problem: Saving snippets or links on mobile requires manually opening a note and pasting, which is slow when capturing on the go.

relations.evidence: Include your Obsidian bookmarked notes (file bookmarks only) in the share menu

summary: Mobile quick-capture plugin that appends text and URLs shared from the OS share menu to pre-configured pinned notes.
